description: U.S. Army Soldiers assigned to U.S. Army Central and representatives of Non-Government Organization’s (NGO) analyze humanitarian aid routes in the Civil-Military Coordination Center (CMCC) on Nov. 24, 2025, in Israel. The CMCC is designed to help facilitate the flow of humanitarian, logistical, and security assistance into Gaza and monitors the implementation of the ceasefire agreement and transit
